articles.title: TD Rebrand And More Human Push Meet Mixed Earnings Outlook
articles.mainIdea: TD Rebrand And More Human Push Meet Mixed Earnings Outlook
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: TD Rebrand And More Human Push Meet Mixed Earnings Outlook. Toronto Dominion Bank, TSX:TD, is rebranding as TD and launching its largest North American marketing campaign since 2019. The new More Human platform will align the brand across Canada and the US and highlight a people centered, digital first focus. The move follows recent controversies and is intended to refresh TD's image and engagement with customers at scale.
